steps.name: mypy-src-zero-errors
ac: cd apps/api && uv run mypy src
cd apps/api && set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; uv run pytest tests/trading -q
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check src/trading/repositories

steps.name: strenum-field-comment-parity
ac: cd apps/api && set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; uv run pytest tests/trading -k strenum -q
cd apps/api && set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; test "$(uv run pytest tests/trading -k strenum --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 12
cd apps/api && uv run mypy src
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check src tests/trading

steps.name: strenum-alias-getattr-axis
ac: cd apps/api && set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; uv run pytest tests/trading -k strenum_alias -q
cd apps/api && set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; test "$(uv run pytest tests/trading -k strenum_alias --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 3
cd apps/api && set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; uv run pytest tests/trading -q
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check tests/trading
